_about: Verified starting valuations, each from a public source. The daily run updates these automatically when a newer closed round with a stated valuation appears in the news. Companies not listed here show NA until a source is found.

OpenAI.note: Post-money, USD 122bn round. A round at c. USD 1.4tn was reported in talks in late September 2026.
OpenAI.source_title: CNBC: OpenAI closes funding round at an USD 852bn valuation

reported.source_title: CoinDesk (citing Bloomberg): OpenAI seeks USD 30bn at c. USD 1.4tn valuation

Anthropic.note: Post-money, USD 65bn Series H. Investors expect an IPO at c. USD 2tn or more; Anthropic has not set an IPO valuation.
Anthropic.source_title: TechCrunch: Anthropic raises USD 65bn, nears USD 1tn valuation ahead of IPO

reported.source_title: PYMNTS (citing the Financial Times): Anthropic could seek USD 2tn valuation in record IPO

Databricks.source_title: MGX: Databricks USD 5bn strategic funding at a USD 190bn valuation

SSI.note: c. USD 2bn round led by Greenoaks. Nvidia's July 2026 investment was made on undisclosed terms.

Figure AI.note: Post-money, Series C led by Parkway Venture Capital.
Figure AI.source_title: Reuters via Yahoo Finance: Figure valued at USD 39bn in latest funding round

Aligned Data Centers.note: Enterprise value in the acquisition by AIP, MGX and GIP, plus USD 5bn committed growth capital.
Aligned Data Centers.source_title: DCD: MGX, AIP and BlackRock's GIP complete USD 40bn acquisition of Aligned Data Centers

Altera.note: Silver Lake bought 51% from Intel; Intel keeps 49%.
Altera.source_title: Silver Lake acquires 51% of Altera from Intel

TikTok US.note: Joint venture deal closed 22 Jan 2026; the final valuation was not officially disclosed.

Khazna.note: Implied by e&'s sale of its 40% stake for USD 2.2bn.
Khazna.source_title: DCD: e& to sell its stake in Khazna Data Centers for USD 2.2bn
